author: Arnav
problem: scores maps each spelling-bee contestant to their score. Return the given contestant's place: one more than the number of contestants who scored higher than them.
bug_description: Counts other contestants with score >= mine instead of score > mine, so contestants tied with this one push them down a place.

comments.accurate: Place is 1 plus the number of contestants who outscored this one
comments.wrong_behavior: Place is 1 plus the number of other contestants who scored at least as much as this one
comments.wrong_location: Score comparison verified; make sure the contestant is never compared with themselves
